title: SMS Spam Collection
citation: Almeida, T. & Hidalgo, J. (2011). SMS Spam Collection [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CC84
selection: Manually inspected subset of seed-42 shuffled candidates 35-260 characters long; not representative random sampling. Excluded explicit/adult, personal-name, control-character and redundant examples. A repeated prize campaign is grouped within train.
modifications: HTML entities decoded and whitespace normalized
Phones, long numbers, some postal contacts replaced with placeholders
Project-specific observation labels and rationales authored separately
review: Automated assistant review; no independent human review
limitations: Historical spam includes advertising; spam is not a verified scam label
Only a small selected subset is annotated for this project
Public benchmark texts may have occurred in base-model pretraining
Redactions apply to the reviewed subset and are not a general PII-removal guarantee
The source contains no iPhone Wi-Fi or system-popup ground truth
